verses.qal-u-liya-kh-tar-makidatin-ma-a-d-duwal: qālū liyā khtar makīdāti maʿa d-duwali taslam bihā min makīdāti wamin ḥiyali
faqultu wal-ḥaqqu fīmā qultu yashhadunī kafāniyā l-quṭbu fī ḥālī ʿani sh-shughali
mā quwwatu l-manṭiqi s-suflā walaw saḥarat ʾamāma quwwati rūḥi l-quṭbi bil-mathali
fakayfa yumkinu lid-dunyā taṣarrufuhā ʾin lam yakun thamma ʾamru llāhi fī l-ʾazali
yā bāraka llāhu jalla llāhu yā ʿajabā yā bāraka llāhu fī ḥalli wamurtaḥali
ʾin kāna sayrī ʾilā l-ʾaghrāḍi min laʿibi la ḥaqqaqa llāhu sayra llaaʿibi r-radhili
ʾin kāna dhāka litaʾayīdi l-ḥaqāʾiqi fī ʿaṣri l-ʾabāṭili ʿaṣri l-jawri waz-zalali
la khayyaba llāhu ẓannī fī taḥḥaquqihi wafī tafaḍḍulihi yā khayra muttakalī
ʾayna l-qayāṣiratu l-ʾulā ṭaghā wabaghā fī l-ʾarḍi wāstaʿbadū l-ʾaḥrāra bil-kutali
ʾayna l-farāʿinu wal-ʾawtādu ʾahlakahum mā ʾahlaka n-nāsa ʾidh jārū ʿalā r-rusuli
dharhum qalīla wamahilhum faʾinna ladā rabbi l-ʿibādi jazāʾa fī khuṭā l-ʿamali
yughnīka mā qālahu l-qurʾānu fī zabadi yamḍī jufāʾa waʾammā n-nafʿu kal-jabali
lil-muslimīna ʿalā l-ʾayyāmi ʿāqibahu ḥusnā waʾirthu ʿalā s-sulṭāni dhū jalali
hadhī l-masājidu bil-ʾadhkāri nāṭiqahu hadhī d-dāʾiru hadhī ʾaqwamu s-subuli
dharhum yakhūḍū wadharhum yalʿabū zamanā ʾaw yulhihim fī llayālī laḥẓaḍu l-ʾamali
dharhum ʿalā mā ʾaqāma llāhu jamʿahumu mina t-takālubi ʾaw bādū maʿa l-khajali
lluʾumu yajrī kamā yajrī ʾukhayyā damu bayna l-ʿurūqi wayastawlī ʿalā l-khulali
waẓ-ẓulmu fīhim wafī ʾābāʾihim khuluqu wal-jawru fīhim wafī l-ʾābāʾi lam yazali
la yaʿrifūna mina l-ʾislami ḥurmatahu wal-ḥumru la taʿrifu l-ʾadnā min l-milali
ʾinnā banī māliki min khayri nisbatihi la yaʿrifu lluʾuma minnā ʾaḥdathu r-rajuli
qadi khtabarnā mina d-dunyā maṭāʿimahā dhuqnā l-marārata dhuqnā jawdata l-ʿasali
walam najid minhumā mā nastalidhdhu bihi ʾila l-ʾibāʾa waʾila ṣawlata l-baṭali
faqulta wal-ḥaqqu fīmā qulta baʿdu lahum kūnū malaʾikaha bil-ʿilmi wal-ḥulali
bal qulta ʾinna ḥayāta l-ʾarḍi wāsiṭatu ʾin ṭābati l-ʾarḍu ṭābat jannatu l-muthuli
fakānati l-himmahu l-ʿulyā l-ʾasāsa lahā hali l-ḥayātu bila hadhī siwā l-fashali
ʾidh himmahu l-marʾi bil-ʾakwāni qāhiratu ʾin kāna thammata nūru llāhi min qibali
mā lis-safāsifi mathwā fī maqāʾilihim hali s-safāsifu ʾila min yadi l-kasali
hadhā hudāka wahadhā minka tarbiyatu tuqarribu dh-dhurwata l-quṣwā ʾilā l-badali
la ʾunkiru d-dahra ʾadnā mā lisubḥatihim la ʾunkiru d-dahra mā fī ṭ-ṭayyī min jumali
lakinnamā l-gharaḍu l-maʾamūlu wuṣlatuhum bidhalika l-khuluqi l-ʾasmā maʿa n-nafali
ʾinnī ʾilayka waʾinnī fīka muʿtaqidu ʾilā lliqāʾi ʾilā l-ʾastāri wal-kilali
bidhā ʾajabtu wamā ʾakhṭaʾatu qawliyā ʾidh qālū liyā khtar makīdāti maʿa d-duwali
walam najid minhumā ʾila hudāka ʾabā l-ʿabbāsi khayra l-hudā fī l-ʾunsi wal-ʿuzali
rafaʿta qīmata hadhā l-jinsi lil-malʾi l-ʾaʿlā bitaṭhīrihi min massati l-khabali
hadhī l-ʿaqāʾidu tastahwī malaʾikaha r-raḥmani hadhī ʿibādātu bila khalali
